scripts.deploy: bun run build && bun run typecheck && bun run test && wrangler deploy
scripts.verify:generated: tmp=$(mktemp -d) && trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --outfile="$tmp/worker.js" --platform=neutral --target=es2020 --format=esm --minify=false --keep-names --external:node:* && cmp "$tmp/worker.js" worker.js
